Definition: from G1909 and G2064; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence:--come (in, upon).
BiblicalUsage: Eperchomai means to come upon — to arrive, to overtake, to fall upon. The Holy Ghost shall come upon Mary; power shall come upon the disciples; in the ages to come God will show the riches of His grace; and miseries shall come upon the rich who heaped treasure in the last days.
TheologicalSignificance: What comes upon us reveals who we are, and both arrivals are certain: the Spirit comes upon the willing, and judgment comes upon the careless. I hold that I should pray for the first coming daily and live ready for the second.
RelatedTopics: Outpouring of the Spirit; Grace; Judgment
RelatedPeople: Mary, Mother of Jesus; Simon Peter; Paul
